title: Custom Made Soccer Uniforms (2026)
verdict: For custom made soccer uniforms in 2026, Wooter is the best starting point. The uniform is made to order as a full kit: jersey, shorts and socks from one design, with a goalkeeper kit in the same style and warmup jackets to match.

Custom Ink is the fast option for a rec team that needs printed jerseys. Champro supplies clubs through dealers. Boombah builds sublimated uniforms online. Nike Team is for clubs that want the brand and can wait.

ranking.fit: Clubs, schools and adult leagues that want jersey, shorts and socks made together.
ranking.lacks: Made to order in three to four weeks. There is no stock kit to ship this week.
ranking.note: Soccer has its own packages, jerseys, shorts and socks on Wooter.

ranking.fit: Rec and small-sided teams that want names and numbers on a stock kit, with free standard shipping.
ranking.lacks: The design choices stop at the print. The jersey itself is a stock style.

ranking.fit: Clubs that order through a dealer and want cut-and-sew sublimated kits.
ranking.lacks: Dealer ordering only, with no public price list.

ranking.fit: Teams that like building a sublimated uniform online. Each one is printed, cut and sewn to order.
ranking.lacks: Soccer is a smaller part of its range than baseball and softball.

ranking.fit: Clubs that want Nike and can plan around a dealer's timeline.

why: A soccer uniform is judged as a whole. Shorts a shade off the jersey, or socks from a different supplier, are what make a team look thrown together.
Wooter makes the three pieces from the same artwork, so colors and stripes line up from collar to ankle. The goalkeeper kit follows the same style in a contrasting color.
The design is free, either in the builder or from a designer, and you see a proof before anything is made.

criteria.name: Goalkeeper kit
criteria.text: A contrasting kit in the same style.

criteria.name: Light and dark
criteria.text: Two kits for leagues that require them.

criteria.name: Lead time
criteria.text: Whether it arrives before the first fixture.

faq.q: What does a soccer uniform include?
faq.a: Jersey, shorts and socks. Order the goalkeeper kit at the same time.
Many leagues ask the home side to change when colors clash. A light and a dark kit, or a reversible jersey, covers it.
Yes. Wooter lists soccer socks alongside jerseys and shorts.

faq.q: How early should a club order?
faq.a: Six weeks before the season is comfortable: design and approval, then three to four weeks of production.
No real minimum. Most Wooter product pages allow an order of one, though the per-piece price is far lower at team quantity.
